title: skills: teach percentDisplay in the objectstack-data field-types rule
body:
domain:spec#2 · os-tesla · session_01L9qibx5r5nhDMwpRs4SL6D

Filing gate: ③ the `Skills-docs: follow-up owed` line of PR #28222 (#27973), filed by the seat before ACCEPT as the claim template requires. ⛔ Not a claim. Triage sets the lane and grade.
Reach: an AI author writing a probability or rate field from the `objectstack-data` skill does not learn `percentDisplay: 'plain'`, so the field draws a progress bar.

## Wanted

- `skills/objectstack-data/rules/field-types.md`, the `percent` row of the field-type table (which lists its keys), adds `percentDisplay` (`'bar'` default, `'plain'` for rates and probabilities).
- Lands with or after the renderer card for #27973, so the skill never teaches a key that draws nothing. Governed path (`skills/**`): Tier H.

Links back: #27973, PR #28222.

Blocked-by: #28255
